eligibility.explanation: Original mouse experiments used identifiable mRNA-LNPs. eGFP mRNA-LNP transfected hepatocytes, endothelial cells, and Kupffer cells, and HGF/EGF mRNA-LNP treatment was linked to measured outcomes in liver-injury models.

composition.value: Ionizable cationic lipid / phosphatidylcholine / cholesterol / PEG-lipid

composition_basis.value: Component identities reported; proprietary ionizable lipid identity and quantitative composition were not reported in the packet.

identity.value: Ionizable cationic lipid (proprietary to Acuitas Therapeutics; pKa 6.0-6.5)

molecular_target.missing_reason: No molecular target reported for eGFP.

delivery_recipient_cell.value: Hepatocytes; subpopulations of endothelial cells and Kupffer cells

therapeutic_target_cell.missing_reason: Cell-transfection experiment did not report a therapeutic target cell.

dose_unit.value: μg eGFP mRNA-LNP per 20 g body weight

encoded_product.value: Hepatocyte growth factor (HGF) and epidermal growth factor (EGF)

dose_unit.value: μg total mRNA-LNP (5 μg HGF + 5 μg EGF)

encoded_product.value: Hepatocyte growth factor (HGF) and epidermal growth factor (EGF)

delivery_recipient_cell.missing_reason: Recipient cell identity was not directly reported for this APAP experiment.

dose_unit.value: μg total mRNA-LNP (5 μg HGF + 5 μg EGF)

assay.value: Flow cytometry of liver non-parenchymal cell fractions

endpoint.value: Percentage of eGFP-positive CD31-positive endothelial cells

comparator.value: None reported for this numerical value

qualitative_outcome.value: Significant percentages of endothelial and immune-cell populations expressed eGFP.

assay.value: Oil Red O staining of liver sections

outcome_value.missing_reason: No numerical outcome value reported in the packet.

qualitative_outcome.value: Sharp decrease of steatosis 2 days after first HGF/EGF mRNA-LNP injection; steatosis was maintained in Poly(C) RNA-LNP-treated mice.

comparator.value: Poly(C) RNA-LNP and Luc mRNA-LNP controls

outcome_value.missing_reason: No numerical ALT value reported in the packet.

qualitative_outcome.value: ALT was restored to normal levels at T2 after HGF/EGF mRNA-LNP; control ALT levels remained significantly greater.

outcome_value.missing_reason: No numerical necrosis value reported in the packet.

qualitative_outcome.value: At 24 h after HGF/EGF mRNA-LNP administration, necrotic areas had accelerated disappearance versus Poly(C) RNA-LNP controls; at 8 h there was no significant improvement.

unresolved_items: The specific chemical identity of the proprietary Acuitas ionizable lipid and quantitative molar composition were not reported.
The packet describes intravenous administration as either retro-orbital or tail-vein injection and does not assign one route to each reported efficacy experiment.
A direct recipient-cell measurement for the APAP experiment was not reported; hepatocyte delivery evidence comes from separate mRNA-LNP cell-identity experiments using the same study formulation.
